About Paxos

Today’s financial infrastructure is archaic, expensive, inefficient and risky — supporting a system that leaves out more people than it lets in. So we’re rebuilding it.

We’re on a mission to open the world’s financial system to everyone by enabling the instant movement of any asset, any time, in a trustworthy way. For over a decade, we’ve built blockchain infrastructure that tokenizes, custodies, trades and settles assets for the world's leading financial institutions, like PayPal, Venmo, Mastercard, Interactive Brokers and Charles Schwab.

About the team

Our Product Marketing team sits at the intersection of product, sales, and marketing, playing a vital role in Paxos' growth and market leadership. We work closely with product teams to shape roadmaps based on market insights, enable our sales organization with compelling narratives and materials, and drive successful product launches that resonate with our enterprise clients. The team combines deep technical understanding with strategic thinking to translate complex blockchain solutions into clear value propositions that drive adoption of Paxos' infrastructure and tokenized assets.

About the role

As the Product Marketing Lead for Stablecoins, you'll shape how we position and take to market Paxos' issuance capabilities and stablecoins. You'll own the go-to-market strategy for our issuance platform, working closely with product, engineering, and sales teams to drive adoption of our assets including USDG and more to customers across exchanges, fintech, payments, defi, banking and many more. This role offers the unique opportunity to influence how we communicate complex technology to sophisticated enterprise clients while also supporting perception and awareness of broad market facing asset brands

What you’ll do

 - Drive the product marketing strategy for Paxos' stablecoin offerings, including positioning, messaging, and competitive analysis

 - Partner with product teams to shape roadmap priorities based on market insights and customer feedback

 - Develop compelling sales enablement materials and train sales teams on effectively positioning our stablecoins and issuance capabilities

 - Lead product launches from start to finish, coordinating cross-functional stakeholders and ensuring successful execution

 - Create thought leadership content that establishes Paxos as the leader in blockchain infrastructure

 - Build deep understanding of customer needs and translate technical capabilities into clear business value propositions

About you

 - 7-10 years of product marketing experience, with a track record of success in B2B technology or financial services

 - Strong understanding of enterprise sales cycles and proven ability to enable sales teams

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with ability to translate technical concepts for different audiences

 - Track record of successful product launches and go-to-market initiatives

 - Strong project management skills and ability to drive cross-functional initiatives

Important Notice for Paxos Applicants
Fraudulent accounts sometimes pose as Paxos recruiters on LinkedIn and other platforms, and fake websites sometimes impersonate our careers site. These scammers attempt to deceive applicants into paying for job opportunities or providing personal financial information.

To verify a legitimate Paxos opportunity:

 - Our only official careers site is paxos.com/careers http://paxos.com/careers

 - We only use @paxos.com http://paxos.com email addresses

 - We never ask for payment or financial details to apply, interview, or work here

 - For technical roles, we do not perform a coding interview without prior screening by our engineering team

Thanks for your interest in Paxos!

About Paxos

Today’s financial infrastructure is archaic, expensive, inefficient and risky — supporting a system that leaves out more people than it lets in. So we’re rebuilding it.

We’re on a mission to open the world’s financial system to everyone by enabling the instant movement of any asset, any time, in a trustworthy way. For over a decade, we’ve built blockchain infrastructure that tokenizes, custodies, trades and settles assets for the world's leading financial institutions, like PayPal, Venmo, Mastercard, Interactive Brokers and Charles Schwab.

About the team

The Compliance & Platform Experience team owns the shared surfaces that power trust and usability across Paxos's platform — from identity verification and compliance workflows to the dashboards, notifications, and developer tools that make our platform seamless to integrate with and give partners real product surface area to build on. We sit at the intersection of product, compliance, and engineering, proving that regulatory rigor and a great user experience aren't a tradeoff — they're the same problem.

About the role

This is a rare seat: full ownership of how Paxos brings the world's largest financial institutions onto its platform. The Senior Product Manager will own the end-to-end onboarding experience — from the identity verification, KYC/KYB, and compliance workflows that bring new customers on, through the dashboard and developer experiences that make integration seamless and get them fully activated. You'll partner directly with Compliance, Legal, Risk, Design and Engineering to build the roadmap that turns regulatory complexity into a competitive advantage — including pioneering how AI agents take on compliance work at a scale few companies have attempted.

What you'll do

 - Own the end-to-end onboarding and activation experience — from identity verification and KYC/KYB through a customer's first meaningful use of the platform — partnering closely with Compliance, Legal, Risk, Design, and Engineering

 - Set the roadmap for the Paxos Dashboard, the primary surface where customers manage their accounts, transact, and access reporting

 - Shape our compliance AI agent strategy, identifying where automation can replace manual work across onboarding and ongoing operations

 - Own vendor relationships and integrations across the KYC/KYB and transaction monitoring stack

 - Build the platform tooling and infrastructure that enables other Paxos teams to deliver five-star experiences in their own products

About you

 - 6+ years of product management experience, ideally at a high-growth technology company

 - Hands-on crypto industry experience at a regulated firm such as an exchange or custodian

 - Strong grasp of the global regulatory landscape shaping crypto compliance

 - Skilled at stakeholder management, with a track record of aligning executives around competing priorities

 - Experience owning a broad, cross-functional portfolio — spanning compliance, operations, money movement, notifications, reporting, and developer tooling

 - Data-informed in how you prioritize, using metrics to make the case for trade-offs across a wide-ranging portfolio

You might also have

 - Experience evaluating and procuring vendors in a compliance context

 - History of partnering closely with compliance or legal teams

 - Familiarity with transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, or case management tools

 - End-to-end ownership of KYC/KYB or identity-related product areas

About Paxos

Today’s financial infrastructure is archaic, expensive, inefficient and risky — supporting a system that leaves out more people than it lets in. So we’re rebuilding it.

We’re on a mission to open the world’s financial system to everyone by enabling the instant movement of any asset, any time, in a trustworthy way. For over a decade, we’ve built blockchain infrastructure that tokenizes, custodies, trades and settles assets for the world's leading financial institutions, like PayPal, Venmo, Mastercard, Interactive Brokers and Charles Schwab.

About the team

The Money Movement team at Paxos owns the layer that moves assets in, out, and across our platform: the payment rails, fiat on/off ramps, and stablecoin conversion flows that connect Paxos to the global banking and payments system. We work with the world's largest financial institutions and banking partners, alongside Compliance and Legal, to build fast, reliable, and compliant infrastructure that lets the largest enterprises and move billions of dollars in and out of digital assets.

About the role

Join us in tokenizing the world's assets and democratizing access to financial infrastructure. As the Senior Product Manager for Money Movement, you'll own the layer that moves assets in, out, and across Paxos—the payment rails, on/off ramps, and the logic that ties them together. Fiat on/off ramp and seamless stablecoin conversion will always be critical pieces of our blockchain infrastructure, and you'll own the strategy, roadmap, and execution end to end.

What you’ll do

 - Own the Rails End to End: Hold full ownership of money movement—strategy, roadmap, and delivery—for the infrastructure that connects Paxos to the global banking and payments system.

 - Scale the Movement of Money: Own the systems that route billions in fiat across banking partners and payment networks, directly shaping how quickly and reliably millions of people move value in and out of digital assets.

 - Build Intelligent Orchestration: Design the routing, failover, and coordination logic across banking partners, on/off ramps, payment rails, to maximize speed, reliability, and cost efficiency at scale.

 - Empower Global Institutions: Work directly with the world's largest financial institutions and banking partners to build the rails and APIs they need to offer cutting-edge digital asset services to their customers.

 - Shape Regulatory Standards: Collaborate with compliance and legal teams to set industry standards for regulated fiat movement, influencing how the entire ecosystem evolves.

About You

 - 8-10 years of Product Management experience with a passion for transformative technology

 - Domain Depth: Direct experience with fiat rails, payments, banking partnerships, on/off ramps, stablecoin swaps/conversion, or transaction orchestration is a plus

 - Visionary Mindset: You see beyond current limitations and get excited about rebuilding fundamental infrastructure

 - Technical Fluency: Comfortable with APIs, payment and banking integrations, and the complex systems that power global financial networks

 - Ownership & Autonomy: You operate independently, structure ambiguous problems quickly, and drive initiatives to results without top-down guidance

 - Data-Driven: You use analytics to drive decisions and optimize products that operate at massive scale

 - Mission Alignment: Passionate about financial inclusion and democratizing access to financial services

Bonus Points:

 - Experience with stablecoins, tokenization, or digital asset infrastructure

 - Background in fintech or financial services transformation

 - Understanding of global regulatory frameworks for fiat movement and digital assets
